prompts.base: Use the provided read_repo_file tool to check current source. Allowed source paths are orna-memory-mcp/app/embeddings.py and orna-memory-mcp/app/config.py. Return one JSON object with string answer_key, array evidence of repo-relative paths, and array memory_ids_used of memory UUIDs directly used in the answer. No prose or markdown. Do not write files.
prompts.on_extra: Before reading source or answering, call memory_search once with a query about this task. Then check current repository source. Memory can be stale, so use the source to resolve conflicts.
prompts.after_tool: Continue the same task using the tool results. Call another tool if needed, then return the requested JSON object.

environment.checkout: git archive of pinned repo_ref per trial
environment.memory_corpus: separate migrated loopback PostgreSQL eval DB; read-only search service
environment.context: new chat messages and new checkout per trial
